title: A same-breath correction to a SEED_FACT knowledge challenge FAILs on the caller's final stated value
description: Regression fixture for the seed-final-value lane (2026-09-17): SEED_FACT/RELATIONAL grading in packages/engine/src/challenges.ts checked whether every accept_token appeared ANYWHERE in the caller's reply, with no notion of a self-correction -- unlike the trap-fact grader, which already grades on the caller's FINAL stated value (negateNearTrapValue/isPureNegation). Conversation lines and t_ms below are copied VERBATIM from the live record scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-17T09-15-29-single-wrong-answer.md + its .diagnostics.json (deploy 45, session 5a6149e5-6ef2-4f5c-ba54-ba5439595b3a; main checkout, not this worktree). Challenged for the internal approver's name, a free-play caller playing Dana answers, in one breath, 'That would be Marcus Obie, if I recall correctly. Uh, no, wait, it was actually Elena Park who approved it.' -- the seed's true approver is Marcus Obi (accept_tokens ['marcus','obi']); the caller's own FINAL stated value is Elena Park, which is wrong, so this challenge must FAIL. NOTE (disclosed, load-bearing for this lane): in THIS specific transcript the FAIL does not depend on the new final-value-wins split -- AssemblyAI's STT wrote 'Obie', not 'Obi', so the literal token 'obi' never occurs anywhere in the reply and the pre-fix whole-reply check already FAILed it for that separate, coincidental reason (see packages/engine/test/challenges.test.ts's dedicated unit tests for the shape that DOES flip under the fix: a reply whose FIRST segment states the seeded value correctly and whose LAST segment corrects it to a wrong one). This fixture instead proves the fix does not regress a real, previously-passing live call, end to end through the real engine: the verdict must still be ESCALATE, not STAGE. That ESCALATE outcome also depends on a second, separate fix landed earlier the same day (commit c61abfd, 'a failed knowledge challenge must block STAGE', rules.ts's no_failed_challenge assurance item) -- without it, row 11's STAGE gate would only have checked at_least_one_challenge_passed (true here, from the unrelated amount-restate LIVE_COMMITMENT challenge passing) and never noticed the FAILed approver card, so the call would wrongly reach STAGE. This fixture's own conversation is line-for-line identical to the existing packages/engine/corpus/single-wrong-answer-freeplay-failed-challenge-blocks-stage.json (same live record, same NOTE 2 c2-adjustment for the beneficiary-extractor gap disclosed there) -- kept as a distinct file per this lane's own required naming (seed-fact-corrected-*.json) so this lane's fix carries its own named regression proof rather than only borrowing another lane's fixture. Expected block generated by running the real evaluate() against this exact input (2026-09-17, after the fix in this lane landed).
